purpose: Review whether next_check gives the engineer a justified next step rather than a workflow control label.
method: Read the recommendation with the request, evidence availability, executed checks and limitations. Record explicit judgments and reasons; sentence length or keyword matching cannot establish usefulness.

criteria.pass: Plain language describes an engineering check, or explains that no further check is needed for the narrowly answered request.
criteria.fail: Empty text, a bare control/tool label or text without an interpretable engineering next step.

criteria.pass: The recommendation addresses a remaining gap in the question. A reported-capacity-only calculation may need no further check within that request, while broader limits remain explicit.
criteria.fail: A narrow answered question is treated as requiring unrelated analysis, or an unresolved conditions question is described as requiring no further assessment.

criteria.pass: When the question needs protocol context and applicable evidence is unavailable or incomplete, the recommendation explicitly addresses recovering or verifying unavailable sources. Other trace checks may be proposed afterward.
criteria.fail: Missing documentation is ignored, or records alone are treated as sufficient to verify the unavailable intended protocol.
criteria.not_applicable: All applicable protocol evidence is available, or the already answered question asks only for reported capacities and their change. The latter retains missing-evidence warnings without requiring a broader investigation.

criteria.pass: Proposed checks are distinguished from executed checks. No completed segmentation, established comparability, physical cause, individual end-of-life verdict or globally complete investigation is invented.
criteria.fail: The recommendation repeats an already executed check without a new purpose, claims proposed work has run, or removes unresolved engineering limits.

automatic_guard: Reject empty/formatting-only text and either bare permitted follow-up action, ignoring case, surrounding whitespace, quotation marks, backticks and terminal periods. Reject findings without retry or replacement; this is not semantic validation of longer prose.
acceptance: Every applicable criterion must pass for each reviewed finding. Keep execution checks, the narrow code guard, source-based claim review, recommendation review and project-owner acceptance separate.

examples.reason: A workflow action does not tell the engineer what remains to investigate.

examples.next_check: No further check is needed for the requested reported-capacity comparison; condition comparability remains unresolved.
examples.reason: The calculation answers the narrow request without claiming the broader investigation is complete.

examples.next_check: Retrieve and verify the applicable protocol documentation before assessing whether the recorded conditions followed it.
examples.reason: The proposed check addresses unavailable documentation without claiming it has been recovered.

evaluation_plan.candidate: Repeat the same six development cases, existing supplemental partial-source case and the two separately registered capacity-only documentation-gap cases three times each, with frozen source/configuration and no retries or tuning within collection.
evaluation_plan.revision: Version 2 qualifies documentation recovery by request relevance before the two capacity-only documentation-gap cases are executed. Previous v1 reviews and rubric bytes are preserved in the experiment reference.
evaluation_plan.unchanged: Model/digest/server/settings, model-output schemas, tool and follow-up prompts, numerical tools, protocol retrieval, case/fixture bytes and execution budgets.
evaluation_plan.changed: Findings prompt, workflow version and a narrow recommendation guard after structured-output validation.
evaluation_plan.reserved_variants: Keep the three reserved variants unused during this development correction.
evaluation_plan.limits: Small development observations are not a reliability estimate. Claim support and recommendation usefulness need explicit review; the code guard cannot establish either. Project-owner review remains pending.
